shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every evening.
My favorite season is autumn with colorful leaves.
Cooking new recipes makes me feel creative.
Traveling to new places helps me learn about cultures.
Listening to music can sometimes uplift my mood.
I often go hiking on weekends to enjoy nature.
Volunteering at the local shelter brings me joy and purpose.
Dancing is a fun way to exercise and express myself.
Learning a new language opens many opportunities for travel.
Spending time with family is important for maintaining connections.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: What is your most memorable travel experience?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of travel in life?
Q4: What would you recommend to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about hobbies and interests.
questions: Q1: What hobby do you enjoy the most and why?
Q2: Have you ever faced any difficulties in pursuing this hobby?
Q3: In your opinion, how do hobbies contribute to happiness?
Q4: What advice would you give someone looking to start a new hobby?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your typical daily eating routine?
Q2: What challenges do you encounter in maintaining healthy eating habits?
Q3: How do you think diet affects our overall well-being?
Q4: What tips would you offer for someone trying to eat healthier?
